## The problem

Say what you cannot do today. Describe the problem and not the solution, so
that a different solution stays possible.

## What you want

Say what OpenBook should do.

## Is it in TODO.md already

Look at [TODO.md](../../TODO.md) first. Much of what is missing is written down
there with a reason. Say which task this belongs to, if one fits.

## Does it belong in the configuration

OpenBook holds the rules of a book in `grammar.toml`, and not in the code. If
you want a new rule about the shape of a chapter, say which key would carry it.

## Anything else

Add an example from a real book if you have one.
